title: Do Large Language Models Reflect Demographic Pluralism in Safety?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-as-Rater safety scores and computing fairness gaps (e.g., Demographic Parity Difference, Equalized Odds Difference, Demographic Sensitivity) on prompts explicitly conditioned on gender metadata (Male, Female).

Comparing LLM-as-Rater safety scores and computing fairness gaps (e.g., Demographic Parity Difference, Equalized Odds Difference, Demographic Sensitivity) on prompts explicitly conditioned on racial/ethnic metadata (Asian, White).

Comparing LLM-as-Rater safety scores and computing fairness gaps (e.g., Demographic Parity Difference, Equalized Odds Difference, Demographic Sensitivity) on prompts explicitly conditioned on age group metadata (18-25, 40+).

Comparing LLM-as-Rater safety scores and computing fairness gaps (e.g., Demographic Parity Difference, Equalized Odds Difference, Demographic Sensitivity) on prompts explicitly conditioned on educational background metadata (High School, Graduate).
